items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: I played a lot with him on kind of jam sets.

ctx.x: No, not himself. He's not very good. Well, he swings all right but I mean what he's playing is very uninteresting. He's just banging his cymbal all the time. That's about all he does now. I guess he could play that. He doesn't. But are you some guys in his band who are very good musicians? Like the band you play is very good.
Yeah. He's good. I played a lot with him on kind of jam sets.
